name: Clínica Brisa
owner: The fictional dental clinic of the DentalOS demo
idea: A tooth, a golden breeze and a paper folio: every visit leaves its next step in writing.
place: The booking portal, the front desk and the waiting room

display.role: Titles, large dates and the folio's figures
display.sample: Every visit has a next step.

text.role: Body text, buttons, labels and states
text.sample: Thursday, October 22, 10:00 · Orthodontic check-up · Centro branch

grid: Tooth and breeze share one axis: the breeze reaches equally far on each side.
The breeze is a circle's arc, crossing the tooth with half a stroke of air.
The gold dot is the module: it spaces symbol and name and sets the clear space.

alt.logo: Clínica Brisa logo: a tooth crossed by a golden breeze, beside the name
alt.secondary: Horizontal version: symbol, name on one line and the demo's tag
alt.submark: Clínica Brisa symbol: tooth, breeze and dot
alt.patterns: Three patterns: breezes laid like scales, a chart of teeth and a month in dots
alt.post: Sample post: “Every visit has a next step” on green
alt.story: Sample story: an appointment reminder with its paper folio
alt.poster: Sample poster on paper: the tooth at large scale and an invitation to book
alt.print: Sample appointment card with a perforated edge and the day in large figures
alt.object: The care kit box in 3D: the symbol in front, the next appointment on the back

source: Colours, typefaces and symbol come from the DentalOS repo. The band of air, the grid, the patterns, the pieces and the box were drawn for this board with sample data.
